desc_zh: 北京时间 11 月 20 日 17:00，Deribit 约 2.83 万枚 BTC 期权到期，最大痛点 73000 美元；到期前后现货价格常向最大痛点附近靠拢，留意波动。
desc_en: About 28,300 BTC in Deribit options expire at 09:00 CET on Nov 20, with max pain at $73,000; spot prices often drift toward max pain around expiry — expect volatility.

title_zh: 美国密歇根大学 11 月消费者信心指数
title_en: University of Michigan November consumer sentiment
desc_zh: 密歇根大学发布 11 月消费者信心指数，反映美国家庭对通胀与就业的预期；信心走弱通常利空风险资产，留意其对 12 月加息预期的影响。
desc_en: The University of Michigan releases its November consumer sentiment index, reflecting US households' expectations on inflation and jobs; weaker confidence usually weighs on risk assets and feeds into December hike expectations.
Official listing on Nov 21; final snapshot Nov 11, wMNEMO must be claimed by Nov 10, wallet registration Nov 12–17. Follow the official timeline.
desc_zh: 官方确认 11 月 21 日上线；11 月 11 日最终快照，wMNEMO 需在 11 月 10 日前领取，钱包注册窗口为 11 月 12–17 日。参与者请按官方时间表操作。

title_zh: 俄罗斯交易所可启动有组织加密交易
title_en: Russian exchanges may start organized crypto trading
desc_zh: 获俄罗斯央行批准交易规则的交易所自 11 月 22 日起可开展有组织加密交易；11 月 17 日起散户已可在年度限额内购买 BTC、ETH 与 USDT，具体参与资格与交易规则以俄央行与交易所公告为准。
desc_en: Exchanges whose trading rules are approved by the Bank of Russia may start organized crypto trading from Nov 22; retail investors can already buy BTC, ETH and USDT within annual limits since Nov 17. Exact eligibility and rules follow Bank of Russia and exchange announcements.

title_zh: OKXICE 代币化证券交易启动
desc_zh: 据报道 OKXICE 将于 11 月 23 日启动代币化证券交易，覆盖美股七巨头在内的 65 家以上公司；具体上线标的与参与门槛以官方公告为准。
desc_en: OKXICE is reported to launch tokenized securities trading on Nov 23, covering 65+ companies including the Magnificent Seven; exact listings and access rules follow official announcements.
Around 16.61B MON unlock (~$450M) — the largest single unlock of the month. Market impact worth watching closely.

title_zh: FLOP Network 测试网启动（暂定）
desc_zh: Arthur Hayes 创立的 AI 算力链 FLOP Network 计划 11 月 24 日启动测试网（此前 11 月 3 日目标已跳票，日期仍为暂定）；测试网挖矿可分 44 亿枚 FLOP 创世空投（矿工/代理/验证者各 12 亿 + 8 亿储备），主网与 TGE 日期尚未确认。参与前以官方页为准，谨防钓鱼。
desc_en: FLOP Network, the AI compute chain founded by Arthur Hayes, plans to start its testnet on Nov 24 (a Nov 3 target already slipped, so the date is tentative); testnet mining earns a share of a 4.4B FLOP genesis airdrop (1.2B each for miners, agents and validators plus an 0.8B reserve). Mainnet and TGE dates are unconfirmed. Verify on official pages and beware of phishing.

title_zh: 美国 10 月 PCE 通胀与三季度 GDP 二次修正值发布
title_en: US October PCE inflation and Q3 GDP second estimate
desc_zh: 美东时间 8:30，美国经济分析局同时发布 10 月 PCE 物价指数（美联储最看重的通胀指标，预期环比 +0.3%、同比 +3.8%）与三季度 GDP 二次修正值（预期年化 +3.5%）；同日还有耐用品订单、初请失业金与美联储褐皮书。这是 12 月 8–9 日 FOMC 会议前最关键的一批数据，直接影响 12 月是否加息的判断。
desc_en: At 8:30 a.m. ET, the BEA releases October PCE inflation — the Fed's preferred gauge, expected +0.3% MoM and +3.8% YoY — plus the second estimate of Q3 GDP (expected +3.5% annualized). Durable goods orders, initial jobless claims and the Fed's Beige Book land the same day. This is the most important data batch before the Dec 8–9 FOMC meeting and will shape the December hike decision.

desc_zh: 约 4.59 亿枚 HUMA 解锁，占总供应量约 4.59%，释放给投资者；流通占比未公布，稀释幅度尚难量化，潜在抛压需留意。
desc_en: ~458.75M HUMA unlock (~4.59% of total supply) to investors; the circulating-supply share is unpublished, so near-term dilution is hard to quantify — watch for potential sell pressure.

desc_zh: Predict Points 持有者须在 11 月 26 日 16:00（北京时间）前选领取方案：A 方案立即领 35%、放弃剩余 65%，B 方案质押一年后领 100%；逾期未选视为放弃。只认官方领取页，谨防钓鱼。
desc_en: Predict Points holders must choose a claim option before 16:00 Beijing time on Nov 26: Option A pays 35% now and forfeits the rest, Option B pays 100% after staking for one year. Missing the deadline means forfeiting. Official claim page only — beware of phishing.

title_zh: 以太坊核心开发者再议 Glamsterdam 升级方案
title_en: Ethereum core developers reconvene on Glamsterdam scope
desc_zh: 以太坊核心开发者 11 月 26 日开会拍板 Glamsterdam 升级是否修改技术规范：维持现有规范则主网最早 2027 年 1 月中旬激活，改规范则可能推迟至 2027 年 4–5 月；争议焦点是 EIP-8037/8038 的 Gas 计价改动可能波及约 1.5 万个智能合约。
desc_en: Ethereum core developers meet Nov 26 to decide whether to revise Glamsterdam's specifications: keeping them could activate mainnet as early as mid-January 2027, while revisions could push it to April-May 2027. At issue are EIP-8037/8038 gas-repricing changes that could affect about 15,000 smart contracts.

title_zh: 美国感恩节：美股休市，现货加密 ETF 停牌
title_en: US Thanksgiving Day: stock markets closed, spot crypto ETFs halted
desc_zh: 美国感恩节假期，美股与债市休市，美国现货加密 ETF 随之停牌一天；周五（11 月 27 日）为缩短交易日，美股 13:00（美东时间）提前收盘。加密现货市场照常交易，但假期流动性偏薄，波动可能放大。
desc_en: US stock and bond markets close for Thanksgiving, so US spot crypto ETFs are halted for the day; Friday Nov 27 is a shortened session with stocks closing at 1 p.m. ET. Crypto spot markets trade as normal, but holiday liquidity is thin and volatility can spike.

title_zh: MSCI 剔除 Strategy（MSTR）正式生效
title_en: MSCI removal of Strategy (MSTR) takes effect
desc_zh: MSCI 11 月指数评审的剔除决定于 11 月 30 日收盘生效，Strategy 将退出 MSCI USA、MSCI World 与 ACWI 指数；跟踪指数的基金须在此之前完成调仓，摩根大通估算被动抛售约 28 亿美元。剔除不等于退市，也不强制 Strategy 卖出比特币。
desc_en: MSCI's November review removal takes effect at the Nov 30 close: Strategy exits the MSCI USA, World and ACWI indexes; index-tracking funds must rebalance by then, with JPMorgan estimating about $2.8B in passive selling. Removal is not a delisting and does not force Strategy to sell bitcoin.

title_zh: LayerZero Zero 主网与 lzATLAS 上线

desc_zh: LayerZero 自有 Layer 1 区块链 Zero 计划 11 月 30 日上线主网，首个应用 lzATLAS 交易所引擎同步上线，初始接入十余家交易场所；这是网络与产品上线，并非空投，LayerZero 尚未公布第二轮 ZRO 空投。只认官方渠道，谨防钓鱼。
desc_en: LayerZero's own Layer 1, Zero, is scheduled to launch mainnet on Nov 30 with its first app, the lzATLAS exchange engine, onboarding more than a dozen trading venues at launch. This is a network and product launch, not an airdrop — LayerZero has announced no second ZRO airdrop. Use official channels only and beware of phishing.

desc_zh: 美国劳工统计局发布 10 月 JOLTS 职位空缺（美东时间 10:00），是 12 月 4 日非农报告前的一份就业市场先行指标；职位空缺走弱会强化降息/不加息预期，反之则支撑 12 月加息押注。
desc_en: BLS releases October JOLTS job openings (10:00 a.m. ET), a leading labor-market read ahead of the Dec 4 jobs report; softer openings would weaken the case for a December hike, while strength supports it.

title_zh: Galxe 奖励领取关闭、网站转为只读
title_en: Galxe reward claims close; site goes read-only
desc_zh: Galxe 宣布并入 Gravity：12 月 5 日为参与活动的最后一天，12 月 15 日奖励领取关闭、整个 Galxe 网站转为只读；未领取的奖励能否追回官方尚未说明，参与者请在 12 月 15 日前完成领取，并以官方 X 公告为准。
desc_en: Galxe is consolidating under Gravity: Dec 5 is the last day to take part in campaigns, and on Dec 15 reward claims close and the whole Galxe site goes read-only. Whether unclaimed rewards remain recoverable is unannounced — claim before Dec 15 and follow the official X announcements.

title_zh: 美国 11 月 PPI 生产者物价指数发布
desc_zh: 美国劳工统计局发布 11 月生产者物价指数（美东时间 8:30），是 12 月 FOMC 会议前最后一批通胀数据之一；PPI 走高会强化 12 月加息预期，利空风险资产。
desc_en: BLS releases November producer prices (8:30 a.m. ET), one of the last inflation prints before the December FOMC meeting; a hot PPI would strengthen December hike expectations and weigh on risk assets.

title_zh: 美国 11 月零售销售发布
desc_zh: 美国人口普查局发布 11 月零售销售（美东时间 8:30，北京时间 21:30），是首份覆盖假日季的消费数据；10 月仅增 0.2%，市场关注消费是否在加息预期升温下走弱。
desc_en: The US Census Bureau releases November retail sales (8:30 a.m. ET) — the first read on holiday-season spending. October rose just 0.2%; markets watch whether consumption is weakening as hike expectations rise.
